title: mallworld dream room - a dingy 80s arcade
content: at some point in every mallworld dream i have, i end up going into an arcade that gives off a similar vibe to this picture. it's dingy and smells musty and the carpet feels weird. usually there's an employee standing behind a prize counter and he asks if i wanna go to the back where the games are. i get a creepy gut feeling that i shouldn't and leave. anyone else have a similar experience?
